newsitem.title: UK: Scottish Radio details profits up 37 pct.
newsitem.headline: Scottish Radio details profits up 37 pct.

text.p: Broadcasting and entertainment services company Scottish Radio Plc on Tuesday reported full-year pre-tax profits rose by 37 percent 7 million stg from 5.1 million in the same period a year ago.
The full-year dividend was increased by 20 percent to 7.8 pence and turnover rose by 66 percent to 28 million stg.
The company said it had made three acquisitions in the previous 12-month period valued at 23 million stg, which "contributed strongly" to advertising revenues in October and November.
"The board is confident of the medium and long-term prospects for the group," the company said. "SRH will continue to seek opportunities to expand."
